body:
Implements build item 1 of docs/specs/operating-stack.md (§8a, §9.1) — completing the WRITE side of per-phase token-spend recording. Read side exists: packages/gate-manifest/lib/spend.mjs defines `usage: { inputTokens, outputTokens, cachedTokens, provider, model, tier }` and `aggregateSpend(entries)`.

WHAT MAIN ALREADY HAS (do NOT duplicate — a prior draft of this ticket re-scoped work that #272 already landed): @adlc/core's complete() supports an `onUsage` side-channel (packages/core/lib/llm.mjs), and coldstart already records per-ticket usage through it (packages/coldstart/lib/gate.mjs) — note its comment: “never fabricate usage.” Coldstart is a P2 gate. What is MISSING is usage on the phases that dominate spend: P4 (build) and P5 (prosecution).

BUILD EXACTLY TWO REAL PRODUCER PATHS:
1. P5 — external-review packet path: extend the review-packet schema (packages/prosecute/lib/schema.mjs) with an OPTIONAL validated `usage` object per pass (spend.mjs field names verbatim); prosecute's manifest record path attaches a valid `usage` to EXACTLY ONE manifest entry per actual model call — the pass-completed entry is the sole usage carrier; pass-started, finding, and dry-pass entries never carry usage (one prosecution pass emits several entries, and copying usage onto each would multiply spend by the entry count). IDEMPOTENCY ACROSS RETRIES: each external model call carries a stable `callId` in the packet; the carrier is deduplicated by (revision, packet identity, callId) — re-running an unchanged packet after a crash or operator rerun appends NO second usage carrier for an already-recorded callId, and a replay whose usage CONFLICTS with the recorded carrier for the same callId is rejected naming the conflict. A packet without callId records usage as usual but is not retry-safe; the schema validator warns. Invalid shapes are rejected with a named validation error; ABSENT usage stays absent (see the no-fabrication rule).
2. P4 — fleet dispatch path: each adapter that can report usage gains an ADAPTER-SPECIFIC PARSER of its harness's documented machine-readable output (e.g. `claude -p --output-format json` result usage; the opencode JSON output mode) — NOT a generic passthrough of a `usage` property on the exec result, which production `spawnAsync` never emits (it returns only status/signal/stdout/stderr/error/timedOut). The parser extracts usage from captured REAL harness output; the fleet's per-ticket gate-manifest recording writes it onto P4 entries with `usageStatus: "reported"`. Harnesses with no machine-readable usage, or malformed output, produce entries WITHOUT `usage` and `usageStatus: "unreported"`.

NO-FABRICATION RULE (binding, matches the existing core contract): when a provider/harness reports no usage block, `usage` is OMITTED — never a zeroed object; a zeroed object would make aggregateSpend count an unmeasured call as a measured free one and collapse “unknown” into “free.” Instead each recorded entry carries a sibling `usageStatus: "reported" | "claimed" | "unreported"`: "reported" is RESERVED for adapter-attested usage parsed from the harness's own machine-readable output (P4 path); caller-supplied packet usage (P5 path) records as "claimed" — shape validation cannot prove a provider actually reported those counters, so packet counters must never masquerade as attested telemetry; absent usage is "unreported". Spend consumers may aggregate claimed usage but must surface the status mix in any finding. Entries also accept optional siblings `channel`, `transport`, `registryDigest` (mandatory only once quartermaster dispatch exists per T151); record when supplied, omit cleanly otherwise; aggregateSpend stays byte-compatible (ignores siblings).

Acceptance criteria (tests drive the REAL producer paths; hand-constructing manifest entries in these tests is a test-integrity failure):
- P5 packet path (exactly-once + claimed): an `adlc-prosecute --input <passes.json>` run whose fixture packet carries per-pass usage attaches it to the pass-completed entry ONLY, with `usageStatus: "claimed"`; a finding-bearing pass emitting pass-started + two findings + pass-completed aggregates to EXACTLY one call and EXACTLY the packet's token totals (assert exact numbers, not nonzero); re-running the SAME packet (same callId) after the first carrier was appended still aggregates to EXACTLY one call (retry idempotency), and a replay with a conflicting usage for that callId is rejected naming the conflict; usage absent records no `usage` key and `usageStatus: "unreported"`; a malformed shape is rejected naming the field; NO code path can record packet-supplied usage as `"reported"` (assert a rejection/downgrade test). Verified by `packages/prosecute/test/usage-packet.test.mjs`.
- P4 fleet path (real-format fixtures): a fleet dispatch driven through the real adapter seam with a stubbed exec whose STDOUT is a captured real-format harness payload (e.g. an actual `claude -p --output-format json` result document) produces a P4 entry whose parsed `usage` aggregates to the EXACT `aggregate.byPhase.P4` total encoded in the fixture, `usageStatus: "reported"`; the same dispatch with plain-text stdout (no machine-readable usage) or a malformed payload yields no `usage`, `usageStatus: "unreported"`, byPhase.P4 zero WITHOUT error; the stub must emulate the production exec result shape (status/stdout/stderr...) — injecting a synthetic `usage` property on the exec result is a test-integrity failure. Verified by `packages/fleet/test/usage-dispatch.test.mjs`.
- Unknown ≠ zero: an entry with `usage` omitted and one with a genuine provider-reported all-zero usage are distinguishable — the former has `usageStatus: "unreported"` and no `usage`; the latter `usageStatus: "reported"` with zeros. Verified by a case in `packages/gate-manifest/test/usage-roundtrip.test.mjs` (assert both shapes).
- Sibling fields: an entry recorded with `{channel, transport, registryDigest}` preserves them verbatim; `aggregateSpend()` output identical with and without them. Verified by `packages/gate-manifest/test/usage-roundtrip.test.mjs`.
- Schema guard: `packages/gate-manifest/lib/spend.mjs` unchanged (rail); gate-manifest, prosecute, and fleet segments green via `node scripts/run-tests.mjs` exit 0.

Context: docs/specs/operating-stack.md §8a is the telemetry contract (rail — do not amend here); issue #272 tracks the remaining gap (P4/P5 write side).
title: Record per-phase usage on gate-manifest entries via the real P4/P5 producers (spend write side, #272 completion)
